newsitem.title: USA: Ocean Reef says Jan Bell offer to expire.
newsitem.headline: Ocean Reef says Jan Bell offer to expire.

text.p: Ocean Reef Management Inc said on Monday it told Jan Bell Marketing Inc that its offer made on October 21, 1996, will expire at 1700 EST on November 5.
The company said Jan Bell's delayed response to Ocean Reef's offer and its refusal to meet or speak with Ocean Reef has "obstructed substantive discussions regarding the future of Jan Bell."

The company said it sent Jan Bell a letter that said Ocean Reef has complied with the terms of its original offer and is confident it can finance its offer if its due diligence confirms the information in public filings.
"Ocean Reef reserves all rights in the future to take any action that would enhance the value of its and other shareholders' investments in Jan Bell Marketing," the company said in a written release.
The company proposed in September to buy Jan Bell for $4.00 per share and later acquired an option to buy a 6.23 percent stake in the company.
On Nov. 1, Jan Bell requested more information from Ocean Reef on the financing and structure of the deal.
